question: How concentrated is the frozen pair-centroid prediction advantage across genes, which improvements recur in both citrus genotypes, and which externally annotated functions are represented?
scope: Post-result attribution and fixed-score sensitivity. Not new held-out validation, new prediction, causal pathway analysis or resolution of CODE7 noisy-subspace uncertainty.
immutable_parent_rule: Verify pins and all six CODE8 NPZ hashes. Do not edit, refit or replace CODE8 predictions, gene panels, coefficients, primary criterion or decisions.
scenario_scope: All six frozen CODE8 genotype/filter scenarios. Primary1.0 separately in each genotype; other thresholds are sensitivity, not independent replication or rescue.
units: Squared error in log2(1+author-deposited FPKM); existing panels and three target RNA pools per genotype.
epsilon_meaning: Numerical zero convention, not biological effect-size or significance threshold.

gene_contribution.meaning: Positive favors centroid. Equal gene mean recovers CODE8 comparator-minus-centroid MSE difference.
retain: target mean and three target values
gene_contribution.inference: Descriptive gene distribution, no genes-as-independent-biological-replicates P values, binomial intervals or gene bootstrap.

concentration.ordering: Descending mean delta, ties by ascending lexical Feature_GID; exactly k genes removed.
reports: each target-library mean gain on same retained set
concentration.denominator_handling: If H or P numerically zero, ratio unavailable with reason, not0. Net-gain shares may exceed1 or be negative; positive-mass shares bounded.
concentration.worst_case_scope: Largest mean-gain deletion minimizes remaining total mean gain for this exact k and unchanged predictions. Same retained set is scored in each target library, not each library own worst-case deletion.
concentration.minimum_positive_prefix: In descending strictly positive delta>epsilon prefix, smallest k with H-sum(top k delta)<=epsilon. Report k,k/G. If no such prefix, unavailable and remaining gain. If initial H<=epsilon, k=0 flagged no-positive-initial-net-gain. This outcome-selected fixed-prediction deletion fraction is not estimator breakdown or biological sparsity.
concentration.interpretation: Report literal persistence after1/5/10% deletion. No new success criterion replaces CODE8.

cross_genotype.universe: Exact Feature_GID intersection of two PRIMARY1.0 panels; report intersection and both original panel sizes.
cross_genotype.shared_per_comparator: For each primary comparator, delta>epsilon in all3 target libraries of BOTH genotypes.
cross_genotype.shared_across_primary_comparators: Intersection of shared-per-comparator sets for all3 primary comparators; strict descriptive shared core.
reports: Pearson and Spearman association of mean contributions without significance tests
within-genotype gain mass of shared sets
same/opposite/zero sign of target-minus-control mean displacement, not DE
cross_genotype.limits: One experiment, shared mapping reference. Six positive signs are not six independent studies. Sets selected on known outcomes, not validated biomarkers.

gene_examples.per_genotype_comparator: Primary panels and3primary comparators. Top20 strictly positive mean gains descending; bottom10 strictly negative ascending; lexical Feature_GID tie-break. If fewer qualifying genes, report all and count.
gene_examples.core_order: On the primary common-gene universe, ascending mean-gain percentile ranks with average tied ranks divided by Gcommon. For strict-core genes, take minimum of all6 ranks (2genotypes x3primary comparators), sort descending then lexical Feature_GID; report top20 and all6ranks.
gene_examples.annotation: Keep original Product,Gene_Symbol,Entrez and external provenance. Do not infer function from gain sign.
gene_examples.selection_disclosure: Illustrative outcome-selected genes, not confirmatory panel.

direction_oracle.fitting: Per frozen scenario/model, u=prediction-C,t=target_mean-C. alpha=dot(u,t)/dot(u,u), unconstrained, no intercept. Exact zero denominator givesalpha0 and zero-norm flag.
direction_oracle.diagnostic: C+alpha*u, evaluated on all3target libraries and target mean.
direction_oracle.label: TARGET_FITTED_GLOBAL_RESCALE_DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_PREDICTION
direction_oracle.limits: Outcome-seen magnitude-versus-direction description. Does not enter CODE8 competition, alter predictions, validate performance or identify true biological span.

annotation_gate.annex: ANNOTATION_ANNEX.json fixed with timestamp/hash by annotation audit before gene gain/rank inspection.
annotation_gate.preferred_source: Authoritative exact-Entrez GO associations with audited assembly/taxon/date and version-compatible ontology. Propagate only is_a and part_of, exclude NOT, and freeze obsolete-term handling in annex.
annotation_gate.stop_rule: No guessed orthology or post-gain category/version changes. If mapping/version compatibility unresolved, report unavailable or fix an explicit descriptive alternative annex before gains.
annotation_gate.duplicate_Entrez_policy: Define duplicates across FULL source feature annotation table. Exclude ALL features carrying a multiply assigned Entrez ID from functional summaries; never choose a representative. CODE8 overall scores preserved.
annotation_gate.functional_eligibility: One valid unambiguous Entrez per feature, no duplicate across source features. Report missing/ambiguous/unmappable identities and GO-unannotated eligible features.
annotation_gate.score_QC: Delete all features carrying duplicated Entrez IDs from fixed scores, no refit. Report mean/net/per-library gains. Missing functional annotations alone do not exclude valid features in duplicate-only QC.
functional_summaries: positive-mass contribution/share of panel positive mass
core member count and descriptive membership ratio vs eligible common background
annotation_gate.small_group_rule: n<20 labelledsmall, retained in complete outputs, not promoted as broad biological conclusions.
annotation_gate.coverage: Report overlaps,unique union coverage,unmatched/unannotated/excluded counts andzero-membergroups. Overlapping group contributions cannot be summed as disjoint components.
annotation_gate.inference: No GO Pvalues or formal enrichment. Attribution of observed prediction gains, not pathway activation or causal tolerance.

reporting: Preserve negative contributions and report all fixed scenarios/contrasts/categories. Corrections/additions explicitly post-result. No universal law, pure higher-order interaction, novel biological dimension or journal-readiness claim.
